bajada: In a large organization, the spreadsheet has the data but not the org chart, the drawing falls behind at the first change, and a cloud service leaves your people's records on another company's servers. BoldoAtlas brings the tree, the positions and the records together in a database on your computer.

cifras.texto: people, 1,000 of them with a photo

nota: Measured on Windows 11, from opening the app to seeing the totals on Home, with a test organization and generated portraits: 0.6 to 0.9 s with optimized or 300 KB photos. The first opening of each folder takes longer because it makes a backup.

items.titulo: The whole structure on one canvas
items.texto: Each card shows the unit's head, the team's faces, the headcount and the vacancies. Zones, with a name and a color, group units from any branch without changing who reports to whom.
puntos: Branches fold away, and the 1, 2, 3 and All buttons choose how many levels you see.
Lateral connections between units: dotted lines with their description, through the free space between cards.
Several trees in one database, and any branch opens as a tree of its own.
Saved views, and highlighting by tag or by text.

imagen.leyenda: The sample organization that comes with the app (16 people)
imagen.alt: Sample org chart: General Management with Operations, Finance and People; Operations open down to Maintenance, Production, Mechanical and Electrical, with heads, headcount and vacancies.

items.titulo: Link the units that work together
items.texto: A connection goes from one unit to another, with a description if you want, and does not change who they report to.
puntos: A dotted line through the free space between cards, with an arrow pointing at the destination unit.
Create it with “Connect to…” from the card or the unit panel; if the other unit is in a collapsed branch, the branch opens by itself.
Change one of the units or reverse the direction; if you delete it, you have 8 seconds to undo.
Hover over a card and its connections stand out while the other lines fade.

imagen.alt: The window of the Maintenance → Purchasing connection, above its dotted line: the description, Change unit, Reverse and Delete connection.

items.titulo: Each organization, apart from the others
items.texto: An organization is a file with its org chart, its people and its lists: it lets you keep different clients, the companies in a group or a test copy.
puntos: Several organizations, each with its data, photos and backups apart: you move between them with their tabs.
Create one, open a .db file or explore the example, without touching the one you have open.
With more than one, Home shows up to 8 recently opened, and one click opens the one you want.
When you open more than one organization, each tab carries the color dot and the name of its own.
Deleting one asks you to type its name, and can keep a copy first.

imagen.alt: Home of Demo Company with its totals, the list of recently opened organizations, the quick access buttons and the buttons to create or open another organization.

items.titulo: Every person's record, tied to their position
items.texto: Each position knows who holds it and who covers it. The record keeps contact, contract, site and shift, with the position history.
puntos: Vacancies in plain sight on every card of the tree.
Your own lists of job titles, contracts, sites and shifts.
Photos are reduced when you choose them: they look the same and weigh much less, in backups and .boldo files too.

imagen.alt: Person record for Andrés Soto: name, email, the unit he heads, his Manager position with its history, contract type, site and shift.

items.etiqueta: The org chart on any date
items.titulo: Look at another day without changing anything
items.texto: Pick or type a date and see who held each position that day, read-only.
puntos: Days with changes are marked on the calendar.
Jump to the previous or next change.
The list of what changed that day: who took over and who covered.

imagen.alt: The org chart as of September 1, 2026, read-only, with the calendar open and that day's change.

enlace.texto: Read how to view a past date

items.titulo: What is worth fixing, on a single screen
items.texto: Review gathers vacant positions, repeated emails, people without a position and more; each row opens what needs fixing.
puntos: Units without a head, vacant positions (with the days they have been so) and people without a current position.
Repeated emails and similar names, as possible duplicates.
Empty units and list values that nothing uses.
The number next to Review in the menu is the total of pending warnings and updates by itself.

imagen.alt: Data review screen with the Vacant positions, Current replacements and Unused values lists.

items.texto: A directory with every person and vacancy, with search, filters and the columns you want.
puntos: Ctrl+K opens the command palette: type and reach any unit or person.
Sort by person, job title or division.
Search inside the diagram too.

imagen.alt: Directory with 18 rows: person, job title, management, area and email, with search, a unit filter and a column picker.

items.titulo: Take the database or a branch to another computer
items.texto: Export saves the whole database, or the branches you check, in a .boldo file encrypted with a code shown only once. When you import, you see what it carries and choose what to do with it:
puntos: As a new organization, the recommended one: it stays apart in your list and the one you have open does not change.
Add what is new: what's missing comes in and what you already have stays as it is.
Review and decide: for two copies that kept changing; you choose what stays, record by record or field by field.
Replace everything: your data is swapped for the file's, only with a file of the whole database.
A backup is made before your data changes, and if something fails nothing is written.

imagen.alt: Import: what the file carries in a table and the As a new organization, Add what is new, Review and decide and Replace everything options.

enlace.texto: Read how to export and import

items.titulo: Carry it on a USB drive, with your data and backups
items.texto: The portable version keeps your data and backups in the datos/ folder, next to the program, and doesn't need the internet to work. On macOS, the system also keeps the window preferences and caches in ~/Library.
puntos: Automatic backup every 24 hours, or as often as you choose, and manual backups whenever you like.
For each organization the 10 most recent are kept, and you restore them from the same screen.
Before changing the database structure, BoldoAtlas keeps a copy.

imagen.alt: Backups section of the settings: last backup, a Back up now button, automatic backup every 24 hours and the list of backups to restore.

items.titulo: On your system, in your language
items.texto: The same app on Windows, Linux and macOS, with the interface in English or Spanish.
puntos: Windows 10 and 11, Linux (AppImage, .deb and .rpm) and macOS 11 or newer, on Intel and Apple Silicon.
The language changes instantly; light theme, dark theme or follow the system.
A manual with numbered screenshots and search inside the app, the same one that is on this site.
When you close the window you can keep BoldoAtlas in the tray and come back instantly.

imagen.alt: The app in Spanish and in dark theme: the menu with Árbol, Árboles, Directorio and Revisión, and the sample org chart.

comparar.texto: We reviewed Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, OrgChart, Buk and Talana on their official sites: criterion by criterion, with the source of every data point.
